findings.title: Unbounded derivative weights invalidate the claimed H-infinity factorization
findings.precise_claim: Bounded analytic inverse branches on openD_R with images inD_r are claimed to induce a bounded transfer map Hinf(D_r)->Hinf(D_R).
findings.evidence: Exact101-branch map withR10,r3/2 and central square-root inverse has bounded branch images and real contraction slopes, satisfies gamma*r<R, but L1 diverges toward boundary10. Full construction and inequalities are in reportProblem1 and current analytic_convergence AC-F1.
hypothesis_checks: Full-branch interval partition and one-sided endpoint convention
All signs positive, so no derivative cancellation
findings.dependency: Proposition2.4 uses the false bounded factor and its potentially infinite constant; its tail estimates feed Proposition2.11 and Theorem2.14/Corollaries2.15-2.17.
findings.scope_limit: Local false auxiliary assertion and substantial missing finite bound in the core quantitative proof; no counterexample to all intended compactness or qualitative spectral-convergence statements.
findings.counterevidence_and_repair: ShrinkRtoRprime withgamma*r<Rprime<R or impose bounded derivatives. The radius-shrinking repair changes constants/rate/Hardy radius, so does not certify the original fixedR quantitative estimate.
findings.severity_reason: A false assertion is explicitly used in a substantial derivation of the central quantitative guarantee; ease of repair alone does not reduce this classification.

editorial_clarifications_not_counted.title: Incorrect negative exponent in Hardy coefficient norm
editorial_clarifications_not_counted.precise_claim: The stated boundary Hardy norm equals sum|f_n|^2R^(-2n).
editorial_clarifications_not_counted.evidence: Forf(z)=z actual norm squared isR^2, notR^-2. Parseval gives sum|f_n|^2R^(2n); summability characterization has same correction.
editorial_clarifications_not_counted.counterevidence_and_repair: Adjacent operative proofs and normalized basis use the correct positive exponent. Replace the two negative exponents.
editorial_clarifications_not_counted.scope_limit: Local printed norm identity; no independent downstream theorem failure established from it.
editorial_clarifications_not_counted.severity_reason: An isolated normalization typo resolved by the actual adjacent proof, without changing its operative argument.
editorial_clarifications_not_counted.scope_correction_reason: The negative Hardy coefficient exponent is a genuine isolated typographical error; the adjacent operative proofs already use the positive exponent. Under operative 0.7.1 it is retained as an uncounted editorial clarification, with no independent downstream defect established.
